recipe.name: White Bean Baked Beans with Turkey Bacon and Egg
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté diced onion and garlic until soft.
Add tomato passata, smoked paprika, and white beans; simmer 8-10 minutes.
In a separate pan, cook turkey bacon until crisp.
Fry or poach the egg to preference.
Serve beans hot topped with turkey bacon and egg.

recipe.name: Chicken and White Bean Soup with Kale
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pot and sauté onion, carrot, celery, and garlic until softened.
Add chicken breast and cook until lightly browned.
Pour in chicken stock, add thyme, and bring to a simmer.
Add white beans and simmer for 10 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Stir in kale and cook 2-3 minutes until wilted.
Serve hot topped with grated parmesan.

recipe.name: BBQ Rubbed Roast Chicken Thighs with Smoky Sweet Potato and Corn
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°C.
Mix smoked paprika, brown sugar, garlic powder, salt, and a splash of vinegar into a dry BBQ rub.
Coat chicken thighs generously in the rub and place on a roasting tray.
Toss cubed sweet potato and corn with olive oil, salt, and a pinch of the rub; arrange around the chicken.
Roast for 22-25 minutes until chicken skin is crisp and sweet potato is tender.
Rest 3 minutes before serving.

recipe.name: Almond and Pumpkin Seed Mix
instructions: Mix whey protein powder with water to form a thick paste and roll into a small ball, or serve as a shake alongside the nuts.
Combine almonds and pumpkin seeds in a small bowl.
Serve together as a snack portion.

recipe.name: Turkey & Spinach Egg Scramble with Feta
instructions: Heat olive oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat and cook turkey mince until browned, breaking it up.
Add cherry tomatoes and cook 2 minutes until softening, then stir in spinach until wilted.
Whisk eggs and pour into the pan, scrambling gently until just set.
Fold in crumbled feta and season with black pepper.
Toast the bread and serve alongside the scramble.

recipe.name: Greek-Style Chicken & Hummus Wrap
instructions: Mix drained tuna with hummus, lemon juice and a drizzle of olive oil.
Warm the tortilla slightly to make it pliable.
Layer lettuce, cucumber and bell pepper strips over the tortilla.
Spoon the tuna-hummus mixture over the vegetables.
Roll tightly into a wrap, slice in half and serve.

recipe.name: Italian Braised Beef Shin in Tomato & Red Wine
instructions: Season beef shin cubes and sear in olive oil over high heat until browned on all sides; set aside.
In the same pot, sauté onion, carrot, celery and garlic until softened.
Deglaze with red wine, scraping up browned bits, and simmer 2 minutes.
Return beef to the pot, add crushed tomatoes, rosemary and bay leaf, plus a splash of water to just cover.
Cover and braise on low heat for at least 2.5-3 hours until meat is fork-tender (use a pressure cooker for a faster 45-minute version if needed).
Rest for 10 minutes off the heat before serving, discarding bay leaf.

recipe.name: Greek Yoghurt with Walnuts & Cinnamon
instructions: Spoon yoghurt into a bowl.
Top with chopped walnuts and a sprinkle of cinnamon.

recipe.name: Cocoa Almond Protein Shake
instructions: Add almond milk, yoghurt, and protein powder to a blender.
Add frozen strawberries, cocoa powder, and almond butter.
Blend on high until smooth and creamy, about 45 seconds.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

recipe.name: Turkey and Farro Bowl with Roasted Vegetables
instructions: Heat a pan over medium-high heat and cook ground turkey with garlic until browned and cooked through, about 8 minutes.
In a separate pan, sauté zucchini and bell pepper in olive oil until tender, about 6 minutes.
Warm the cooked farro and place in a bowl.
Top with turkey and roasted vegetables.
Drizzle with lemon juice, sprinkle parsley and salt, and serve warm.

recipe.name: Greek White Bean and Cod Curry
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté onion and garlic until softened, about 4 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes, cannellini beans, oregano, and a splash of water; simmer 8 minutes.
Add cod cubes and gently simmer until fish is opaque and cooked through, about 6-7 minutes.
Stir in lemon juice, dill, and salt.
Serve warm with a side of steamed greens or crusty bread if desired.

recipe.name: Cottage Cheese with Kiwi and Walnuts
instructions: Spoon cottage cheese into a small bowl.
Top with sliced kiwi and chopped walnuts.
Serve immediately.

recipe.name: Greek Yoghurt with Walnuts, Chia and Raspberries
instructions: Spoon yoghurt into a bowl and whisk in the protein powder until smooth.
Top with chopped walnuts, chia seeds and fresh raspberries.
Serve immediately.

recipe.name: Cured Turkey, Cottage Cheese and Crudité Plate

ingredients.name: Sliced smoked turkey breast (deli, no fillers)

instructions: Arrange turkey slices and a scoop of cottage cheese on a plate.
Add cucumber, cherry tomatoes and pepper strips around the plate.
Drizzle olive oil over the vegetables and scatter almonds and dill on top.
Serve cold with no cooking required.

recipe.name: Vietnamese Lemongrass Pork and Vegetable Tray Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°C. Toss pork slices with lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce and half the sesame oil.
Spread pork, carrots, shallot and broccoli on a lined tray, drizzle remaining sesame oil.
Roast for 18-20 minutes, tossing halfway, until pork is cooked and vegetables are tender-charred.
Remove from oven, squeeze lime juice over the tray and scatter chili and coriander.
Serve directly from the tray.

recipe.name: Chili-Lime Spiced Boiled Eggs
instructions: Boil eggs for 9 minutes, then cool in cold water and peel.
Halve eggs and arrange with cherry tomatoes on a small plate.
Squeeze lime juice over and sprinkle with chili powder and sea salt.
Serve immediately.

recipe.name: Smoked Mackerel & Cottage Cheese Scramble
instructions: Melt butter in a non-stick pan over medium-low heat.
Whisk eggs with cottage cheese and pour into pan, stirring gently as they set.
Add spinach and halved cherry tomatoes, cook until just wilted.
Flake smoked mackerel and fold in gently to warm through.
Season with pepper and scatter chives.
Serve with a slice of toasted rye bread.

recipe.name: Sardine & White Bean Salad
instructions: Arrange salad leaves, cucumber, pepper and red onion on a plate.
Scatter cannellini beans and crumbled feta over the top.
Place drained sardines on top of the salad.
Whisk olive oil and lemon juice, drizzle over salad.
Garnish with chopped parsley and black pepper.

recipe.name: Cajun Chicken & Shrimp Stir Fry

ingredients.name: Cajun spice blend (paprika, cayenne, garlic powder, thyme, oregano, black pepper)

instructions: Toss chicken and shrimp with half the Cajun spice blend.
Heat a wok or heavy skillet over high heat, melt half the butter.
Sear chicken until nearly cooked, about 3-4 minutes, remove and set aside.
Add remaining butter, stir-fry peppers, celery and onion over high heat for 2-3 minutes.
Add garlic and remaining spice blend, cook 30 seconds.
Return chicken to pan, add shrimp and chicken stock, stir-fry until shrimp is pink and cooked through.
Garnish with sliced green onion and serve hot.

recipe.name: Mixed Nut & Pumpkin Seed Mix
instructions: Combine almonds, pumpkin seeds and walnuts in a small bowl.
Serve as is, unsalted and raw or lightly toasted.

recipe.name: Slow-Baked White Beans with Bacon and Eggs
instructions: Soak white beans overnight, then simmer in water for 60 minutes until tender; drain.
In an oven-safe pot, sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until soft.
Add diced bacon and cook until browned.
Stir in tomato passata, smoked paprika, and cooked beans; season with salt and pepper.
Transfer to a 160°C oven and bake covered for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove from oven, make two small wells and crack in the egg, cover and bake 8 more minutes until set.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.

recipe.name: Moroccan-Spiced Lentil and Chicken Soup
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot; sauté onion, carrot, and celery until softened, about 8 minutes.
Add garlic, cumin, and turmeric; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add diced chicken and sear until lightly browned on all sides.
Pour in chicken stock and add rinsed red lentils.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 30 minutes until lentils are soft.
Stir in lemon juice, adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.
Ladle into a bowl and top with fresh cilantro before serving.

recipe.name: Grilled Skirt Steak Tacos con Nopales y Salsa Verde
instructions: Rub skirt steak with olive oil, cumin, salt, and pepper; let marinate 20 minutes at room temperature.
Char nopales and onion slices on a hot grill until tender and lightly blackened, about 6 minutes.
Grill tomatillos and serrano pepper until softened and charred, about 5 minutes; blend with cilantro and lime juice to make salsa verde.
Grill the steak over high heat 3–4 minutes per side for medium-rare; rest 5 minutes, then slice against the grain.
Warm corn tortillas on the grill for 20 seconds per side.
Assemble tacos with sliced steak, grilled nopales-onion mix, avocado slices, and salsa verde.

recipe.name: Greek Yoghurt with Toasted Walnuts and Cinnamon
instructions: Toast chopped walnuts in a dry pan over low heat for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Spoon Greek yoghurt into a bowl.
Top with toasted walnuts and a sprinkle of cinnamon.

recipe.name: Spinach, Feta & Mushroom Omelette
instructions: Melt half the butter in a nonstick pan and sauté mushrooms until golden, about 5 minutes.
Add spinach and cook until wilted; remove vegetables and set aside.
Whisk eggs with black pepper, pour into the pan with remaining butter over medium-low heat.
Scatter cooked vegetables and feta over the eggs as they set.
Fold the omelette in half once mostly set, cook 1 more minute, then slide onto a plate.
Toast the bread and serve alongside.

recipe.name: Turkish-Spiced Lamb & Yoghurt Wrap
instructions: Mix lamb mince with cumin, paprika, minced garlic and a pinch of salt.
Heat olive oil in a pan and cook the spiced lamb over medium-high heat until browned and cooked through, about 8 minutes.
Warm the tortilla wrap in a dry pan for 30 seconds each side.
Spread yoghurt over the wrap, then layer cucumber, tomato, red onion and parsley.
Top with cooked lamb, roll tightly into a wrap, slice in half and serve.

recipe.name: Tandoori-Style Roast Chicken Leg with Masala Roasted Vegetables

ingredients.name: Chicken leg (drumstick and thigh), skin on, bone in

instructions: Mix yoghurt, ginger, garlic, garam masala, turmeric, chilli powder and lemon juice into a marinade.
Score the chicken leg and coat thoroughly with marinade; refrigerate at least 1 hour, ideally longer.
Preheat oven to 200°C. Toss cauliflower, carrot and red onion wedges with mustard oil and a pinch of the same spice mix.
Place marinated chicken on a roasting tray with vegetables arranged around it.
Roast for 40-45 minutes, turning vegetables once, until chicken is cooked through and skin is charred in spots.
Rest 5 minutes, garnish with fresh coriander and serve.

recipe.name: Cottage Cheese with Berries and Walnuts
instructions: Spoon cottage cheese into a small bowl.
Top with blueberries and chopped walnuts.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and serve immediately.
